# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `rastro config --output markdown`; edit the models,
src/rastro/config_descriptions.py or src/rastro/config_catalog.py instead. -->

Every option Rastro accepts, generated from its code: job-file keys, Python keyword
arguments, operator grants, environment variables and command-line flags. Job files reject
unknown keys, and `rastro job validate` suggests the closest valid one. If what you need is
not here, check [Capabilities](capabilities.md) and write a gap report instead of inventing
an option.

- `rastro config --output json` prints this reference; MCP clients read
  `rastro://configuration`.
- `rastro job template` prints an annotated job file with every option commented;
  `rastro job template --all` adds every recipe, field, source, model and rule variant.

## Job file

A path names a key: `sources[].url` is `url` inside a `[[sources]]` entry, and
`acquisition.egress_profiles.<name>.proxy_url` is `proxy_url` under
`[acquisition.egress_profiles.NAME]`. Keys listed under a variant exist only when that
discriminator value is set. "Same keys as" means the table repeats another one.

### Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format_version` | integer | required | `always 1` | Job format; always 1. |
| `recipe_version` | integer | - | `>= 1, <= 2147483647` | Serve this stored recipe version from recipe_memory. |
| `discover_recipes` | boolean | `false` |  | Try deterministic recipe discovery when no recipe is given. |
| `discovery_aliases` | table of array of string | - | `keys <= 100` | Extra names per declared field that discovery may match. |
| `recipe_memory` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | SQLite file where recipes are remembered and versioned. |

### `[[sources]]`

Pages to read: URLs, local files, or a bare URL string. Docs: [jobs.md#sources-recipes-memory-and-providers](jobs.md#sources-recipes-memory-and-providers).

#### `kind = "url"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sources[].kind` | string | `"url"` | `always "url"` | Source kind; url is implied by the url key. |
| `sources[].render` | string | `"http"` | `one of http, browser, stealth` | Rendering for this source; overrides acquisition.render. |
| `sources[].url` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 8192` | Page URL; its host must be in acquisition.allowed_hosts. |
| `sources[].representation` | string | `"html"` | `one of html, json` | Body format, html or json; must match the recipe strategy. |
| `sources[].region` | table | - |  | Regional settings for this source only. Same keys as `region`. |
| `sources[].recipe` | table | - |  | Recipe for this source only; it replaces the job's [recipe]. Same keys as `recipe`. |
| `sources[].every` | string | - | `length >= 2, length <= 16` | Reload interval for this source under `job watch`, such as "1h". |

#### `kind = "file"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sources[].kind` | string | `"file"` | `always "file"` | Source kind; file is implied by the path key. |
| `sources[].path` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | Local file, relative to the job file. |
| `sources[].url` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 8192` | URL recorded as the page's provenance; nothing is fetched. |
| `sources[].representation` | string | `"html"` | `one of html, json` | Body format, html or json; must match the recipe strategy. |
| `sources[].region` | table | - |  | Regional settings for this source only. Same keys as `region`. |
| `sources[].recipe` | table | - |  | Recipe for this source only; it replaces the job's [recipe]. Same keys as `recipe`. |
| `sources[].every` | string | - | `length >= 2, length <= 16` | Reload interval for this source under `job watch`, such as "1h". |

### `[[fields]]`

The record fields to extract, with their types. Docs: [jobs.md#target-fields-and-dynamic-schema](jobs.md#target-fields-and-dynamic-schema).

#### `type = "string"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fields[].name` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 64, pattern ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$` | Field name: a letter, then letters, digits or underscores. |
| `fields[].required` | boolean | `true` |  | When true, a record without this field is rejected. |
| `fields[].null_values` | array of string | `[]` | `items <= 16` | Text placeholders rejected after stripping whitespace and case folding. |
| `fields[].type` | string | `"string"` | `always "string"` | Value type; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `fields[].min_length` | integer | - | `>= 0, <= 1000000` | Shortest allowed text. |
| `fields[].max_length` | integer | - | `>= 1, <= 1000000` | Longest allowed text. |
| `fields[].pattern` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | Regular expression the whole value must match. |

### `[acquisition]`

How URLs are fetched: allowed hosts, rendering, pacing, budgets. Docs: [acquisition.md#policy-defaults](acquisition.md#policy-defaults).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `acquisition.allowed_hosts` | array of string | required | `items >= 1, items <= 64` | Exact hosts Rastro may fetch; nothing else is reached. |
| `acquisition.render` | string | `"http"` | `one of http, browser, stealth` | http fetches HTML; browser renders JavaScript; stealth needs the --allow-stealth grant. |
| `acquisition.solve_challenges` | boolean | `false` |  | Let the stealth browser solve challenge pages. |
| `acquisition.allow_http` | boolean | `false` |  | Allow plain http:// URLs (https only by default). |
| `acquisition.session` | boolean | `false` |  | Keep cookies in memory across the requests of one job run. |
| `acquisition.max_concurrency` | integer | `4` | `>= 1, <= 32` | Requests in flight at the same time. |
| `acquisition.max_requests` | integer | `30` | `>= 1, <= 100` | Request budget per source, pages and retries included. |
| `acquisition.max_sources` | integer | `100` | `>= 1, <= 1000` | Most URL sources one job may declare. |
| `acquisition.min_interval_seconds` | number | `1` | `>= 0, <= 60` | Pause between requests to the same host. |
| `acquisition.request_timeout_seconds` | number | `15` | `> 0, <= 120` | Time limit for one request. |
| `acquisition.operation_timeout_seconds` | number | `60` | `> 0, <= 600` | Deadline for one fetch, queues, robots, redirects and retries included. |
| `acquisition.max_redirects` | integer | `5` | `>= 0, <= 10` | Redirects followed per request. |
| `acquisition.max_retries` | integer | `2` | `>= 0, <= 3` | Retries after a temporary failure. |
| `acquisition.backoff_seconds` | number | `1` | `> 0, <= 30` | First wait before a retry; it doubles each time. |
| `acquisition.max_retry_delay_seconds` | number | `30` | `> 0, <= 120` | Longest local wait before a retry; a valid Retry-After is never shortened. |
| `acquisition.egress_profiles` | map of tables | - | `keys <= 16` | Named HTTP(S) proxies; used only with --allow-egress. |
| `acquisition.egress_profiles.<name>.proxy_url` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 2048` | Proxy URL, without credentials. |
| `acquisition.egress_profiles.<name>.username_env` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the proxy user name. |
| `acquisition.egress_profiles.<name>.password_env` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the proxy password. |
| `acquisition.auth` | array of tables | `[]` | `items <= 8` | Request headers whose values come from environment variables. |
| `acquisition.auth[].host` | string | required |  | Allowed host that receives the header. |
| `acquisition.auth[].header` | string | `"Authorization"` | `` pattern ^[!#$%&'*+.^_`\|~0-9A-Za-z-]{1,64}$ `` | Header name. |
| `acquisition.auth[].value_env` | string | required | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the header value. |
| `acquisition.auth[].scheme` | string | - | `` pattern ^[!#$%&'*+.^_`\|~0-9A-Za-z-]{1,64}$ `` | Prefix placed before the value, such as "Bearer". |

### `[region]`

Locale, languages, timezone, currency and egress for every source. Docs: [acquisition.md#metrics-and-regional-behavior](acquisition.md#metrics-and-regional-behavior).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `region.locale` | string | `"und"` | `length >= 2, length <= 64` | BCP 47 locale such as "es-ES"; "und" means unknown. |
| `region.languages` | array of string | `[]` | `items <= 20` | Accepted languages, in order, for Accept-Language. |
| `region.timezone` | string | `"UTC"` | `length >= 1, length <= 128` | IANA timezone used to read dates without one. |
| `region.currency` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$` | ISO 4217 currency code of prices. |
| `region.egress` | string | `"direct"` | `pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$` | Egress profile name, or "direct" for no proxy. |

### `[context]`

Recipe-memory identity: template, region and schema revision. Docs: [memory.md#identity-and-validation](memory.md#identity-and-validation).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context.template` | string | `"page"` | `pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$` | Page template name the recipe is for. |
| `context.region` | string | `"default"` | `pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$` | Region label that separates otherwise equal recipes. |
| `context.schema_revision` | string | `"1"` | `pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$` | Change it to keep recipes of a changed schema apart. |

### `[limits]`

Size and count limits for pages, JSON and records. Docs: [api.md#inputs](api.md#inputs).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limits.max_html_bytes` | integer | `2000000` | `>= 1, <= 20000000` | Largest HTML page read. |
| `limits.max_records` | integer | `1000` | `>= 1, <= 10000` | Most records one extraction returns. |
| `limits.max_jsonld_blocks` | integer | `100` | `>= 1, <= 1000` | Most JSON-LD blocks read from one page. |
| `limits.max_json_bytes` | integer | `2000000` | `>= 1, <= 20000000` | Largest JSON document read. |
| `limits.max_json_depth` | integer | `32` | `>= 1, <= 256` | Deepest JSON nesting read. |
| `limits.max_json_nodes` | integer | `100000` | `>= 1, <= 1000000` | Most JSON values read from one document. |

### `[recipe]`

How records are found on a page; one of four strategies. Docs: [api.md#recipe-variants](api.md#recipe-variants).

#### `strategy = "css"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recipe.strategy` | string | `"css"` | `always "css"` | Recipe kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `recipe.fields` | map of tables or string or array | required | `keys >= 1, keys <= 100` | Maps each declared field name to its selector or pointer. |
| `recipe.fields.<name>.each` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | Relative CSS scope selector or absolute JSON pointer with one wildcard segment. |
| `recipe.fields.<name>.members` | table of string | - | `keys <= 32` | Named scalar expressions relative to each item; excludes value. |
| `recipe.fields.<name>.value` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | One scalar expression relative to each item; excludes members. |
| `recipe.version` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 2147483647` | Recipe version number, kept in history and memory. |
| `recipe.require_evidence` | boolean | `false` |  | Reject a record when a required field has no evidence. |
| `recipe.fallbacks` | array of tables | `[]` | `items <= 3` | Up to 3 other recipes, tried in order when this one finds nothing. Same keys as `recipe`. |
| `recipe.pagination` | table | - |  | Follow next-page links with this recipe (keys below). |
| `recipe.pagination.next` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | Expression that finds the next-page link. |
| `recipe.pagination.max_pages` | integer | `5` | `>= 1, <= 50` | Most pages followed per source. |
| `recipe.record_selector` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | CSS selector of one record; fields are relative to it. |

#### `strategy = "jsonld"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recipe.strategy` | string | `"jsonld"` | `always "jsonld"` | Recipe kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `recipe.fields` | map of tables or string or array | required | `keys >= 1, keys <= 100` | Maps each declared field name to its selector or pointer. Same keys as `recipe.fields.<name>`. |
| `recipe.version` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 2147483647` | Recipe version number, kept in history and memory. |
| `recipe.require_evidence` | boolean | `false` |  | Reject a record when a required field has no evidence. |
| `recipe.fallbacks` | array of tables | `[]` | `items <= 3` | Up to 3 other recipes, tried in order when this one finds nothing. Same keys as `recipe`. |
| `recipe.pagination` | table | - |  | Follow next-page links with this recipe (keys below). Same keys as `recipe.pagination`. |
| `recipe.item_type` | string or array of string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 256; items >= 1, items <= 8` | JSON-LD @type (or up to 8) a record must have. |

#### `strategy = "json"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recipe.strategy` | string | `"json"` | `always "json"` | Recipe kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `recipe.fields` | map of tables or string or array | required | `keys >= 1, keys <= 100` | Maps each declared field name to its selector or pointer. Same keys as `recipe.fields.<name>`. |
| `recipe.version` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 2147483647` | Recipe version number, kept in history and memory. |
| `recipe.require_evidence` | boolean | `false` |  | Reject a record when a required field has no evidence. |
| `recipe.fallbacks` | array of tables | `[]` | `items <= 3` | Up to 3 other recipes, tried in order when this one finds nothing. Same keys as `recipe`. |
| `recipe.pagination` | table | - |  | Follow next-page links with this recipe (keys below). Same keys as `recipe.pagination`. |
| `recipe.record_path` | string | required | `length <= 1024` | JSON pointer to the list of records; empty means the whole document. |

#### `strategy = "embedded_json"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recipe.strategy` | string | `"embedded_json"` | `always "embedded_json"` | Recipe kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `recipe.fields` | map of tables or string or array | required | `keys >= 1, keys <= 100` | Maps each declared field name to its selector or pointer. Same keys as `recipe.fields.<name>`. |
| `recipe.version` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 2147483647` | Recipe version number, kept in history and memory. |
| `recipe.require_evidence` | boolean | `false` |  | Reject a record when a required field has no evidence. |
| `recipe.fallbacks` | array of tables | `[]` | `items <= 3` | Up to 3 other recipes, tried in order when this one finds nothing. Same keys as `recipe`. |
| `recipe.pagination` | table | - |  | Follow next-page links with this recipe (keys below). Same keys as `recipe.pagination`. |
| `recipe.source` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | CSS selector of the node that holds the JSON, ending in ::attr(name) or ::text. |

### `[model]`

Optional AI model that proposes selectors, never records. Docs: [ai.md#connect-a-model](ai.md#connect-a-model).

#### `provider = "ollama"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model.cost_per_call` | number | - | `>= 0, <= 1000` | Cost counted for each call, in your own unit. |
| `model.max_cost` | number | - | `> 0, <= 1000000` | Stop calling the model when the summed cost would pass this. |
| `model.provider` | string | `"ollama"` | `always "ollama"` | Model provider kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `model.model` | string | required | `pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,199}$` | Model name as the provider knows it. |
| `model.base_url` | string | `"http://127.0.0.1:11434"` | `length >= 1, length <= 2048` | Endpoint URL; loopback unless the operator allows remote models. |
| `model.base_url_env` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the Ollama URL. |

#### `provider = "http" or "openai_compatible"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model.cost_per_call` | number | - | `>= 0, <= 1000` | Cost counted for each call, in your own unit. |
| `model.max_cost` | number | - | `> 0, <= 1000000` | Stop calling the model when the summed cost would pass this. |
| `model.provider` | string | `"http"` | `one of http, openai_compatible` | Model provider kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `model.model` | string | required | `pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,199}$` | Model name as the provider knows it. |
| `model.base_url` | string | `"http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1"` | `length >= 1, length <= 2048` | Endpoint URL; loopback unless the operator allows remote models. |
| `model.base_url_env` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the endpoint URL (needs allow_remote). |
| `model.api_key_env` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the API key. |
| `model.allow_remote` | boolean | `false` |  | Declare that page content may leave the machine (operator must agree). |
| `model.response_format` | string | `"json_schema"` | `one of json_schema, json_object` | How the endpoint is asked for JSON. |
| `model.token_limit` | string | `"max_tokens"` | `one of max_tokens, max_completion_tokens` | Name of the output-token parameter the endpoint expects. |
| `model.temperature` | number | `0` | `>= 0, <= 2` | Sampling temperature; 0 is the most stable. |

#### `provider = "command"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model.cost_per_call` | number | - | `>= 0, <= 1000` | Cost counted for each call, in your own unit. |
| `model.max_cost` | number | - | `> 0, <= 1000000` | Stop calling the model when the summed cost would pass this. |
| `model.provider` | string | `"command"` | `always "command"` | Model provider kind; it decides which of the keys below apply. |
| `model.argv` | array of string | required | `items >= 1, items <= 64` | Command and arguments, run without a shell; prompt on stdin. |
| `model.allow_remote` | boolean | `false` |  | Declare that page content may leave the machine (operator must agree). |
| `model.local` | boolean | `false` |  | Declare that the command keeps page content on this machine. |
| `model.timeout` | number | - | `> 0, <= 3600` | Seconds the command may run. |
| `model.output` | string | `"json"` | `one of json, text` | json reads a JSON reply; text reads plain text. |
| `model.json_path` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}){0,7}$` | Dotted path to the answer inside a JSON reply. |
| `model.env` | array of string | `[]` | `items <= 32` | Environment variables passed to the command. |

### `[inference_policy]`

Call, time, size and concurrency budgets for the model. Docs: [ai.md#cost-and-call-budgets](ai.md#cost-and-call-budgets).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inference_policy.max_calls` | integer | `2` | `>= 1, <= 4` | Model calls per extraction. |
| `inference_policy.max_repair_attempts` | integer | `1` | `>= 0, <= 3` | Model repair attempts per extraction. |
| `inference_policy.timeout_seconds` | number | `30` | `> 0, <= 300` | Time limit for one model call. |
| `inference_policy.max_context_bytes` | integer | `32768` | `>= 1, <= 262144` | Largest page context sent to the model. |
| `inference_policy.max_response_bytes` | integer | `65536` | `>= 1, <= 1048576` | Largest model reply read. |
| `inference_policy.max_output_tokens` | integer | `2048` | `>= 1, <= 8192` | Output tokens requested per call. |
| `inference_policy.context_tokens` | integer | `8192` | `>= 512, <= 32768` | Context window assumed for the model. |
| `inference_policy.max_concurrency` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 16` | Model calls in flight at the same time. |
| `inference_policy.max_discovery_candidates` | integer | `8` | `>= 1, <= 32` | Recipe candidates the model may propose. |

### `[dataset]`

Where approved records are stored and what identifies a record. Docs: [jobs.md#dataset-block-and-preview](jobs.md#dataset-block-and-preview).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataset.name` | string | required | `pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$` | Dataset name: lowercase letters, digits and underscore. |
| `dataset.path` | string | `"rastro-state.sqlite"` | `length >= 1, length <= 1024` | SQLite file, relative to the job file. |
| `dataset.backend` | string | `"sqlite"` | `one of sqlite, postgres` | sqlite (a file) or postgres (needs dsn_env). |
| `dataset.dsn_env` | string | - | `pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$` | Environment variable holding the PostgreSQL connection string. |
| `dataset.schema` | string | `"rastro"` | `pattern ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$` | PostgreSQL schema for the dataset tables. |
| `dataset.identity` | array of string | required | `items >= 1, items <= 8` | Declared fields that together identify one record. |
| `dataset.approve` | array of string | - | `items >= 1, items <= 100` | Fields that are stored; all declared fields when omitted. |
| `dataset.match_fields` | array of 3 strings | - | `items >= 3, items <= 3` | Two label fields and one timestamp field for near matches. |
| `dataset.match_tolerance_minutes` | integer | - | `>= 1, <= 10080` | Time difference still counted as a near match. |

### `[[consistency]]`

Semantic rules checked on every run and before repair promotion. Docs: [consistency.md#rules](consistency.md#rules).

#### `kind = "after_observation"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `consistency[].kind` | string | required | `always "after_observation"` | Rule kind. |
| `consistency[].field` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 128` | Declared datetime field the rule checks. |
| `consistency[].tolerance_minutes` | integer | `0` | `>= 0, <= 525600` | Minutes before the observation still accepted. |
| `consistency[].max_violation_ratio` | number or integer | `0.0` | `>= 0, <= 1` | Share of records allowed to break the rule. |

#### `kind = "distinct_ratio"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `consistency[].kind` | string | required | `always "distinct_ratio"` | Rule kind. |
| `consistency[].field` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 128` | Declared field the rule checks. |
| `consistency[].min_ratio` | number or integer | `0.5` | `> 0, <= 1` | Lowest share of distinct values among records. |
| `consistency[].min_records` | integer | `3` | `>= 2, <= 100000` | Records needed before the rule is checked. |

#### `kind = "historical_shift"`

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `consistency[].kind` | string | required | `always "historical_shift"` | Rule kind. |
| `consistency[].field` | string | required | `length >= 1, length <= 128` | Declared field the rule checks. |
| `consistency[].max_shift` | number or integer | required | `> 0, <= 1000000` | Largest allowed change of the median versus history. |
| `consistency[].unit` | string | `"days"` | `one of days, ratio` | days compares datetimes; ratio compares numbers. |
| `consistency[].min_history` | integer | `3` | `>= 1, <= 1000000` | Past loads needed before the rule is checked. |

### `[repair]`

Gates a repair candidate must pass before it may serve. Docs: [repair.md](repair.md).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repair.auto_promote` | boolean | `false` |  | Promote a candidate that passes every gate without review. |
| `repair.min_records` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 100000` | Records a candidate must extract. |
| `repair.min_historical_fixtures` | integer | `1` | `>= 1, <= 32` | Past pages a candidate must still extract. |
| `repair.min_completeness` | number | `1.0` | `>= 0, <= 1` | Share of required values a candidate must fill. |
| `repair.min_structural_validity` | number | `1.0` | `>= 0, <= 1` | Share of records that must validate. |
| `repair.min_semantic_confidence` | number | `1.0` | `>= 0, <= 1` | Consistency score a candidate must reach. |
| `repair.model` | boolean | `false` |  | Use the RASTRO_MODEL model in repair when the job has no [model]. |
| `repair.fixtures` | array of string | `[]` | `items <= 31` | Extra Mock Lab bundle directories, relative to the job file. |

### `[schedule]`

Run interval for `rastro job watch`. Docs: [operations.md#scheduler](operations.md#scheduler).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule.every` | string | required |  | Run interval such as "30m", "6h" or "1d". |
| `schedule.jitter` | string | - |  | Random delay added to each run, at most a quarter of every. |

### `[scroll]`

Scroll a rendered page to load more records. Docs: [jobs.md#scroll](jobs.md#scroll).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scroll.max_steps` | integer | `10` | `>= 1, <= 30` | Most scroll steps per page. |
| `scroll.settle_ms` | integer | `500` | `>= 100, <= 3000` | Longest wait after a scroll before the page is read. |
| `scroll.stop_when` | string | `"no_new_records"` | `always "no_new_records"` | When scrolling ends; the only value is no_new_records. |

### `[spider]`

Follow links from listing pages to detail pages. Docs: [jobs.md#spider](jobs.md#spider).

| Key | Type | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spider.mode` | string | `"list"` | `one of list, spider` | list reads only the sources; spider follows links from them. |
| `spider.seed` | string | `"page"` | `one of page, sitemap` | page starts from each source; sitemap reads a sitemap source. |
| `spider.seed_order` | string | `"document"` | `one of document, reverse, lastmod` | Order sitemap locs before max_pages: document, reverse or lastmod (newest first). |
| `spider.max_depth` | integer | `2` | `>= 1, <= 4` | Link levels followed from a start page. |
| `spider.max_pages` | integer | `25` | `>= 1, <= 100` | Most pages fetched per start URL. |
| `spider.same_host` | boolean | `true` |  | Stay on the start page's host. |
| `spider.allow` | array of string | `[]` | `items <= 32` | Path prefixes (whole segments); only matching links are followed. |
| `spider.deny` | array of string | `[]` | `items <= 32` | Path prefixes (whole segments) that are never followed; deny wins. |
| `spider.allow_pattern` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 512` | Regular expression a link's path must match; deny still wins. |
| `spider.deny_pattern` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 512` | Reject matching decoded paths before the page cap (linear-time regex). |
| `spider.links` | value or array of value | - | `items >= 1, items <= 8` | One CSS attribute expression or a list (up to eight); no comma groups. |
| `spider.link_field` | string | - | `length >= 1, length <= 128` | Declared field whose value in each record is a link. |

## Python keyword arguments

`rastro.AcquisitionPolicy(...)` takes the `[acquisition]` keys, `rastro.Limits(...)` takes the `[limits]` keys.

### `rastro.scrape`

Docs: [api.md#scrape](api.md#scrape).

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `str \| Path` | required | URL, file path or HTML string to read. |
| `schema` | `type[T]` | required | Pydantic model of one record; `rastro.css(...)` defaults are selectors. |
| `records=` | `str \| None` | - | CSS selector of one record when the model has no selectors. |
| `fields=` | `Mapping[str, str] \| None` | - | Field name -> selector, instead of selectors on the model. |
| `recipe=` | `Recipe \| None` | - | A full Recipe; replaces records and fields. |
| `url=` | `str \| None` | - | Provenance URL for a file or HTML target; nothing is fetched. |
| `memory=` | `str \| Path \| None` | - | SQLite file that remembers and versions the recipe. |
| `repair=` | `RepairMode` | `"propose"` | What to do when the recipe breaks: "propose", "auto" or "off". |
| `locale=` | `str` | `"en-US"` | Locale used to read numbers and dates. |
| `limits=` | `Limits \| None` | - | Size and count limits (`rastro.Limits`). |
| `model=` | `ModelChoice` | - | Optional AI model: a spec string, "env" for RASTRO_MODEL, or a ModelPort. |

### `rastro.fetch`

Docs: [api.md#adapters-fetch-and-load-your-own-records](api.md#adapters-fetch-and-load-your-own-records).

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `str` | required | URL to fetch; its host must be allowed by the policy. |
| `policy=` | `AcquisitionPolicy \| None` | - | AcquisitionPolicy; defaults to allowing only the URL's host. |
| `representation=` | `Representation` | `"html"` | "html" or "json": the body format expected. |
| `max_bytes=` | `int \| None` | - | Largest body read; defaults to the matching Limits value. |
| `locale=` | `str` | `"en-US"` | Locale sent as Accept-Language. |

### `rastro.load_records`

Docs: [api.md#adapters-fetch-and-load-your-own-records](api.md#adapters-fetch-and-load-your-own-records).

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `job` | `str \| Path` | required | Job file that supplies dataset, fields and identity. |
| `records` | `Sequence[Mapping[str, object]]` | required | Records your code built, one mapping per record. |
| `source_url=` | `str` | required | URL the records came from, kept as provenance. |
| `observed_at=` | `datetime \| None` | - | When the records were observed; now when omitted. |
| `allow_absolute_paths=` | `bool` | `false` | Allow an absolute dataset path in the job. |
| `allow_remote=` | `bool` | `false` | Operator grant: allow job-declared remote endpoints. |
| `allow_env=` | `Iterable[str]` | `[]` | Operator grant: extra environment variables the job may read. |

### `rastro.run_job_file`

Docs: [api.md#declarative-jobs](api.md#declarative-jobs).

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `str \| Path` | required | Job file (.toml or .json). |
| `allow_absolute_paths=` | `bool` | `false` | Allow absolute source, memory and dataset paths. |
| `acquisition=` | `AcquisitionPort \| None` | - | Your own AcquisitionPort instead of the built-in fetcher. |
| `model=` | `ModelPort \| None` | - | A ModelPort that replaces the job's [model]. |
| `allow_remote=` | `bool` | `false` | Operator grant: allow job-declared remote model endpoints. |
| `allow_egress=` | `bool` | `false` | Operator grant: use the job's egress proxies. |
| `allow_stealth=` | `bool` | `false` | Operator grant: allow render = "stealth". |
| `allow_env=` | `Iterable[str]` | `[]` | Operator grant: extra environment variables the job may read. |
| `allow_private_network=` | `bool` | `false` | Operator grant: reach private addresses of allowed hosts. |
| `allow_ports=` | `Iterable[int]` | `[]` | Operator grant: ports allowed besides 80 and 443. |
| `ignore_robots=` | `Iterable[str]` | `[]` | Operator grant: hosts whose robots.txt is not enforced. |
| `max_model_cost=` | `float \| None` | - | Cost cap for model calls in this run. |
| `model_cost_per_call=` | `float \| None` | - | Cost counted per model call in this run. |

## Operator grants

Only the person running Rastro can grant these; a job file never can.

| Flag | Also | What it allows | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow-remote` | env RASTRO_ALLOW_REMOTE, Python allow_remote= | Job-declared models may use non-loopback endpoints; page content leaves the machine. | [jobs.md#operator-opt-in](jobs.md#operator-opt-in) |
| `--allow-stealth` | env RASTRO_ALLOW_STEALTH, Python allow_stealth= | Allow render = "stealth" and challenge solving. | [acquisition.md#javascript-pages](acquisition.md#javascript-pages) |
| `--allow-egress` | env RASTRO_ALLOW_EGRESS, Python allow_egress= | Use the egress proxies the job declares. | [acquisition.md#network-egress](acquisition.md#network-egress) |
| `--allow-env` | env RASTRO_ALLOWED_ENV, Python allow_env= | Environment variables, besides RASTRO_*, that job keys and proxy credentials may read. | [jobs.md#operator-opt-in](jobs.md#operator-opt-in) |
| `--allow-private-network` | env RASTRO_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK, Python allow_private_network= | Reach private, loopback and CGNAT addresses of allowed hosts. | [acquisition.md#operator-permissions](acquisition.md#operator-permissions) |
| `--allow-port` | env RASTRO_ALLOWED_PORTS, Python allow_ports= | Ports allowed besides 80 and 443. | [acquisition.md#operator-permissions](acquisition.md#operator-permissions) |
| `--ignore-robots` | env RASTRO_IGNORE_ROBOTS, Python ignore_robots= | Hosts whose robots.txt is not fetched or enforced; you assert permission. | [acquisition.md#operator-permissions](acquisition.md#operator-permissions) |
| `--allow-override-gates` | Python allow_override_gates= | `rastro mcp`: let the agent promote a recipe that failed its gates. | [mcp.md#agent-in-the-loop](mcp.md#agent-in-the-loop) |
| `--override-gates` | Python override_gates= | `rastro recipe promote`: promote a candidate that failed its gates (needs --reason). | [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands) |

## Environment variables

Besides the grant variables above. Values are never stored in job files.

| Variable | What it does | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RASTRO_MODEL` | Default model spec, such as "ollama:qwen3"; used by scrape(model="env"), Studio Ask AI, `new --search model` and [repair] model = true. | [ai.md#connect-a-model](ai.md#connect-a-model) |
| `RASTRO_MODEL_LOCAL` | Set to 1 to declare that a RASTRO_MODEL command keeps content local. | [ai.md#privacy](ai.md#privacy) |
| `RASTRO_ON_FAILURE` | Command run with a JSON summary when job load, run or watch needs attention. | [operations.md#failure-hook](operations.md#failure-hook) |
| `RASTRO_SEARXNG_URL` | SearXNG endpoint for `rastro new --goal --search searxng`. | [jobs.md#start-from-a-goal](jobs.md#start-from-a-goal) |

## Command line

Output is JSON unless a flag says otherwise.

### Global flags

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--verbose` | flag | - |  | Write structured logs to stderr |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | - |  | Let job-declared models use non-loopback endpoints (page content leaves) |
| `--allow-stealth` | flag | - |  | Allow stealth browser rendering (also RASTRO_ALLOW_STEALTH=1) |
| `--allow-egress` | flag | - |  | Use the egress proxies the job declares (also RASTRO_ALLOW_EGRESS=1) |
| `--allow-env` | NAME (repeatable) | - |  | Let the job's model keys and egress proxy credentials read this environment variable besides RASTRO_* (repeatable; also RASTRO_ALLOWED_ENV) |
| `--allow-private-network` | flag | - |  | Reach private, loopback and CGNAT addresses of allowed hosts; link-local and cloud metadata stay blocked (also RASTRO_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=1) |
| `--allow-port` | N (repeatable) | - |  | Also allow this port besides 80/443 (repeatable; also RASTRO_ALLOWED_PORTS) |
| `--ignore-robots` | HOST (repeatable) | - |  | Do not fetch or enforce robots.txt for this exact host: you assert you have permission (repeatable; also RASTRO_IGNORE_ROBOTS) |

### `rastro dataset`

Read dataset records and freshness. Docs: [dataset.md#load-inspect-and-export-a-job](dataset.md#load-inspect-and-export-a-job).

### `rastro dataset export`

Print a dataset's records as JSON, JSONL or an HTML table. Docs: [dataset.md#load-inspect-and-export-a-job](dataset.md#load-inspect-and-export-a-job).

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PATH` | Path | required |  | Dataset SQLite file |
| `--dataset` | value | - |  | Dataset name (required if file contains multiple datasets) |
| `--format` | value | `"json"` | one of json, jsonl, html | Output format |
| `--sort-field` | value | - |  | Field to sort records by (ISO date for --upcoming) |
| `--upcoming` | flag | - |  | Only records dated today or later |
| `--timezone` | value | `"UTC"` |  | IANA timezone that decides today |

Show each source's freshness and last load. Docs: [dataset.md#load-inspect-and-export-a-job](dataset.md#load-inspect-and-export-a-job).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `--dataset` | value | - |  | Dataset name (required if file contains multiple datasets) |
| `--format` | value | `"json"` | one of json, jsonl | Output format |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PATH` | Path | required |  | Dataset SQLite file |
| `--to` | int | `4` |  | Target dataset schema version |

### `rastro health`

Stale sources, open drift and pending repairs of a job; exit 4 if any. Docs: [operations.md#one-health-check](operations.md#one-health-check).

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | Path | required |  | Job file (.toml or .json) |
| `--output` | value | `"table"` | one of table, json | Human table or JSON |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |

### `rastro recipe`

Manage stored recipes: repair, promote, rollback, compare, apply, show, prune, export and import. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

### `rastro recipe export`

Write a recipe bundle for sharing in Git. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | Path | required |  | Job file whose recipe memory holds the recipe |
| `--source` | int | `1` |  | One-based source index |
| `--sample` | Path | required |  | Redistributable sample file |
| `--to` | Path | required |  | Bundle directory |
| `--id` | value | - |  | Package identifier |
| `--version` | value | - |  | Semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH |
| `--author` | value | - |  | Package author name |
| `--author-url` | value | - |  | Optional package author URL |
| `--license` | value | - |  | SPDX license identifier |
| `--public` | flag | - |  | Mark bundle as public |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |

### `rastro recipe import`

Verify a recipe bundle and store it as a candidate. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIRECTORY` | Path | required |  | Bundle directory to import |
| `--store` | Path | required |  | Recipe SQLite file |

### `rastro recipe publish`

Verify a public bundle and write it into a local Git registry directory. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIRECTORY` | Path | required |  | Exported bundle directory |
| `--registry` | Path | required |  | Local registry directory |

### `rastro recipe search`

Search a Git registry (directory or https URL) by id or source pattern. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `QUERY` | value | required |  | Substring to match against id or source_patterns |
| `--registry` | Path | - |  | Local registry directory |
| `--registry-url` | URL | - |  | https URL that serves the registry directory (index.json and recipes/); no credentials or query. Needs the [http] extra; never promotes |

### `rastro recipe install`

Verify and install a recipe package from a Git registry as a candidate. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PACKAGE` | value | required |  | Package id or id@version |
| `--registry` | Path | - |  | Local registry directory |
| `--registry-url` | URL | - |  | https URL that serves the registry directory (index.json and recipes/); no credentials or query. Needs the [http] extra; never promotes |
| `--store` | Path | required |  | Recipe SQLite file |

### `rastro recipe prune`

Delete old recipe versions that are not serving. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--store` | Path | required |  | Recipe memory SQLite file |
| `--older-than` | DAYS | required |  | Delete versions older than this many days |
| `--dry-run` | flag | - |  | Count without deleting |

### `rastro recipe repair`

Propose, evaluate and store repair candidates for broken sources. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | Path | required |  | Job file (.toml or .json) |
| `--source` | int | - |  | One-based source index; repair defaults to all sources |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |
| `--report` | value | - |  | New report path inside the job directory |
| `--model` | SPEC | - |  | Model spec for rastro.model, or 'env' for RASTRO_MODEL: propose repairs relocation cannot find and judge them |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | - |  | Allow sending page content to a non-loopback or hosted model |
| `--max-model-cost` | USD | - |  | Stop calling the model once this cost would be exceeded (needs --model-cost-per-call or the job's [model] cost_per_call; overrides max_cost) |
| `--model-cost-per-call` | USD | - |  | Price of one model call; overrides the job's [model] cost_per_call |

### `rastro recipe promote`

Re-check a stored candidate on the current page and activate it if it passes. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | Path | required |  | Job file (.toml or .json) |
| `--source` | int | `1` |  | One-based source index; repair defaults to all sources |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |
| `--version` | int | required |  | Stored version |
| `--reason` | value | - |  | Why, kept in the recipe history |
| `--override-gates` | flag | - |  | Activate a quarantined candidate; requires --reason |

### `rastro recipe rollback`

Make a version that served before active again. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | Path | required |  | Job file (.toml or .json) |
| `--source` | int | `1` |  | One-based source index; repair defaults to all sources |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |
| `--version` | int | required |  | Stored version |
| `--reason` | value | - |  | Why, kept in the recipe history |

Show which fields and selectors differ between two stored versions. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |

| `FILE` | Path | required |  | Job file (.toml or .json) |
| `--source` | int | `1` |  | One-based source index; repair defaults to all sources |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |

| `--to-version` | int | required |  | Newer version |

Write the serving recipe from recipe_memory back into the job file. Docs: [repair.md#commands](repair.md#commands).

| `--source` | int | `1` |  | One-based source index; repair defaults to all sources |
| `--allow-absolute-paths` | flag | - |  | Allow absolute paths in the job file |

### `rastro suggest`

Suggest a CSS recipe from a saved page and example values. Docs: [suggest.md#from-the-command-line](suggest.md#from-the-command-line).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PAGE` | Path | required |  | Saved HTML page |
| `--url` | value | - |  | Address the page was saved from |
| `--example` | FIELD=VALUE (repeatable) | - |  | Example value; repeating a field starts the next example record |
| `--field` | NAME (repeatable) | - |  | Field to extract without an example (requires --model) |
| `--model` | SPEC | - |  | Model spec for rastro.model, or 'env' for RASTRO_MODEL: propose the recipe; examples become optional |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | - |  | Allow sending page content to a non-loopback or hosted model |
| `--max-model-cost` | USD | - |  | Stop calling the model once this cost would be exceeded (needs --model-cost-per-call or the job's [model] cost_per_call; overrides max_cost) |
| `--model-cost-per-call` | USD | - |  | Price of one model call; overrides the job's [model] cost_per_call |
| `--records-min` | int | `2` |  | Minimum records (default 2) |
| `--output` | value | `"json"` | one of json, table | JSON or a human table |

### `rastro new`

Create a job file from a saved page, known sites or a goal. Docs: [suggest.md#create-a-job-file](suggest.md#create-a-job-file).

| Flag | Value | Default | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | Path | required |  | New .toml job file; never overwritten |
| `--output-file` | Path | - |  | New .toml job file |
| `--from` | Path | - |  | Saved HTML page |
| `--goal` | value | - |  | Research goal text for source discovery |
| `--site` | URL (repeatable) | - |  | Page URLs to scrape |
| `--fields` | A,B (repeatable) | - |  | Field names to propose |
| `--search` | value | - | one of searxng, model | How --goal finds candidate sources |
| `--approve` | HOST (repeatable) | - |  | Hosts you approve for fetching |
| `--url` | value | - |  | Address the page was saved from |
| `--example` | FIELD=VALUE (repeatable) | - |  | Example value; repeating a field starts the next example record |
| `--field` | NAME (repeatable) | - |  | Field to extract without an example (requires --model) |
| `--model` | SPEC | - |  | Model spec for rastro.model, or 'env' for RASTRO_MODEL: propose the recipe; examples become optional |
| `--allow-remote` | flag | - |  | Allow sending page content to a non-loopback or hosted model |
| `--max-model-cost` | USD | - |  | Stop calling the model once this cost would be exceeded (needs --model-cost-per-call or the job's [model] cost_per_call; overrides max_cost) |
| `--model-cost-per-call` | USD | - |  | Price of one model call; overrides the job's [model] cost_per_call |
| `--records-min` | int | `2` |  | Minimum records (default 2) |
| `--dataset` | value | - |  | Dataset path for approved records, relative to the job |
| `--identity` | value (repeatable) | - |  | Record key field |
| `--recipe-memory` | FILE | - |  | Recipe store relative to the job, enabling repair (folder must exist) |
| `--allow-partial` | flag | - |  | Write the job even if the recipe preview is only a partial success |
